coverage: Density of supplied valid, finite flow pixels; primary uses 31x31 convolution footprint with stride16 and padding15 excluding outside-image padding; coarse control uses adaptive grid bins.
constant_coverage_fallback: Preserve original attention exactly when coverage is spatially constant, including all-valid and all-invalid frames.
max_pooling: Unchanged per-channel maximum over all original feature cells for every policy.
cnn_inputs_and_weights: Identical original cached inputs and frozen trained CNN weights for all policies; no additional zeroing or confidence threshold.
episode_diagnostics: Same four saved episode-629 windows, used only for explanation, not selection or tuning.

selection.advance_to_training_planning_only_if: Primary candidate strictly improves aggregate validation mean ground error, has no aggregate guardrail regression, and adds no depth or prefix failures; inspect motion families. This is a screening rule, not a generalization claim.
selection.independence: Windows overlap within one scene. No independent held-out estimate or completed history gate is claimed.
selection.hyperparameter_search: None in this experiment; no floor sweep or retrospective primary-candidate change.

scope: Analysis-only attention intervention; no production-model change and no automatic training.
